localStores.name: cm-field-outbox

stores.name: outbox
stores.purpose: Queued field mutations waiting to sync to the server (field-outbox.ts)
stores.evictionSemantics: Items with status="synced" auto-purged after 24 hours. Failed/pending items retained indefinitely until manual discard or success.
stores.durabilityBehavior: Best-effort browser storage. Subject to browser storage quotas, clearing of site data, or Safari 7-day ITP eviction if web app is not visited.

stores.name: drafts
stores.purpose: Unsent field entries saved locally first (raw form state as typed by user)
stores.evictionSemantics: Explicit user deletion or promotion to outbox upon Send. No automatic TTL eviction.
stores.durabilityBehavior: Isolated per user. Persisted in IndexedDB with in-memory React state mirror.

stores.name: queries
stores.purpose: Whitelisted React Query read snapshots for instant offline tab rendering (field-query-persist.ts)
stores.evictionSemantics: LRU pruning: entries older than 7 days pruned on launch; hard cap per entry to prevent storage bloat.
stores.durabilityBehavior: Transient offline read cache; marked as stale on hydrate to trigger background refetch when online.

localStores.schemaVersioning: Version 3 (migrates incrementally: v1 outbox -> v2 drafts -> v3 queries). Service worker sw.js matches version 3 to prevent VersionError.
localStores.swIntegration: Public/sw.js registers `sync` event tag `cm-field-sync` to replay outbox entries in background on Android Chrome.

localStores.name: ConstructionManager_PdfCanvas

stores.name: drafts
stores.purpose: PDF takeoff markups, calibrations, and measurement session drafts
stores.evictionSemantics: LRU pruning: retains top 3 revisions per document. Evicts oldest drafts when count exceeds threshold.
stores.durabilityBehavior: Dual-write: writes to localStorage synchronously and IndexedDB asynchronously. Errors caught and swallowed; falls back to localStorage.

localStores.schemaVersioning: Version 1. Document payload schema validated via `parseCanvasDoc` / `recoverCanvasDoc`.

stores.name: worksheet-localStorage
stores.purpose: Synchronous local snapshot of unsaved grid edits to recover from browser crashes or network dropouts
stores.evictionSemantics: Cleared upon successful server save queue flush (`workbook-save-queue.ts`) or manual reload.
stores.durabilityBehavior: Fragile: 5MB browser quota limit. Large workbooks (>50k rows) fail `setItem` and throw QuotaExceededError (swallowed by try/catch).

stores.name: queue
stores.purpose: Legacy request queue (pre-S2). Retained only so users can inspect and discard stranded writes.
stores.durabilityBehavior: Deprecated: never auto-replayed because server lacked universal idempotency contract.

localStores.name: Client App Preferences & Session Cache

stores.name: preferences
stores.purpose: Cached user profile snapshot, active project selection, UI theme preference

localStores.swIntegration: Service worker inspects session cookie or /api/auth/me.

offlineWorkflows.formState: Draft saved in IndexedDB `drafts` store via `saveFieldDraft`
offlineWorkflows.submissionTrigger: User taps "Send" button on mobile field interface
offlineWorkflows.replayMechanism: Queued into `outbox` with unique device-generated `clientUuid` (UUIDv4). Replayed via `fetch("/api/trpc/fieldSubmission.submitFieldReport")`. Replay triggered on `window.online`, tab focus, manual "Sync now", or SW background sync.
offlineWorkflows.idempotencyContract: Device `clientUuid` sent in payload. Server checks `IdempotencyRecord` and returns cached result on replay.
offlineWorkflows.conflictResolution: Client-wins for draft creation; server validates project lock and permissions at ingestion time. Failures classified as 4xx "needs attention" vs 5xx "transient backoff".

offlineWorkflows.formState: Captured via camera input; resized on HTML5 canvas to <=1280px JPEG q0.75; stored as base64 DataURL in draft
offlineWorkflows.submissionTrigger: Included with daily report submission or sent via `fieldPhotos.create`
offlineWorkflows.replayMechanism: Embedded inside JSON payload if <20MB, or uploaded to pre-signed S3 URL with client-calculated SHA-256 checksum. Replayed sequentially with submission.
offlineWorkflows.idempotencyContract: Deduplicated via file content SHA-256 digest on server `StoredFile` registry.
offlineWorkflows.conflictResolution: Immutable photo identity; duplicate uploads reuse existing `StoredFile` record.

offlineWorkflows.replayMechanism: Queued to outbox; legacy `siteExpense.create` endpoints automatically rewritten to `fieldSubmission.create` envelope by `resolveReplayRequest()`.
offlineWorkflows.idempotencyContract: Device `clientUuid` bound to `withIdempotency` scope on server.
offlineWorkflows.conflictResolution: Office review required: expenses hit temporary `FieldSubmission` table and do not post to financial ledger until approved by project manager.

offlineWorkflows.submissionTrigger: User confirms gate delivery on phone
offlineWorkflows.idempotencyContract: Enforces `clientUuid` idempotency check before adjusting `MaterialTransaction` stock.
offlineWorkflows.conflictResolution: Stock adjustments are additive; rejected if store location or project is invalid.

offlineWorkflows.formState: Autosaved every 2 seconds to IndexedDB `ConstructionManager_PdfCanvas` + localStorage mirror
offlineWorkflows.submissionTrigger: Manual "Save Markups" button or periodic sync
offlineWorkflows.replayMechanism: Direct HTTP POST of `DrawingMarkup` JSON array to `document.saveMarkups`.
offlineWorkflows.idempotencyContract: None currently: whole-drawing markup array overwrite using page index.
offlineWorkflows.conflictResolution: Last-write-wins at markup layer. Known risk: concurrent annotators overwrite each other.

offlineWorkflows.submissionTrigger: Debounced 1500ms after last cell edit, or window blur
offlineWorkflows.replayMechanism: Flushes full serialized `WorksheetDocument` JSON payload to `worksheet.saveDocument`.
offlineWorkflows.idempotencyContract: Integer revision counter (`version: number`). Server increments version on each save.
offlineWorkflows.conflictResolution: Optimistic concurrency: server rejects save if incoming version does not match current database revision.

documentFormats.name: Worksheet Workbook (.xlsx / JSON)
documentFormats.internalStructure: JSON object: `{ documentId, version, sheets: [{ id, name, cells: { [coord]: { raw, value, type, formula, style } } }] }`
documentFormats.compatibilityStatus: Full read/write with Microsoft Excel .xlsx via `@e965/xlsx`. Formulas evaluated via `@formulajs/formulajs` and custom AST evaluator.

documentFormats.name: CAD Vector Drawing (.dxf / .dwg)
documentFormats.internalStructure: Parsed CAD entity graph: `{ layers, blocks, entities: [{ type: "LINE"|"LWPOLYLINE"|"TEXT"|"ARC"|"CIRCLE"|"HATCH", vertices, layer, color }] }`
documentFormats.compatibilityStatus: DXF full ASCII compatibility; DWG native parser handles R2000–R2018 geometry. Plot engine exports to PDF / SVG.

documentFormats.name: Takeoff & PDF Canvas Document (.pdf / JSON)
documentFormats.internalStructure: `DrawingMarkup`: `{ id, drawingId, pageNumber, type: "polygon"|"area"|"length"|"count", points: [[x,y]], scale, measurement }`
documentFormats.compatibilityStatus: Standard PDF rendered via PDF.js worker; markup layers stored as normalized coordinate vectors independent of zoom.

documentFormats.name: Primavera P6 Schedule (.xer)
documentFormats.producingEngine: N/A (External enterprise export from Primavera P6)
documentFormats.internalStructure: Tabular database dump: `%T TASK`, `%T TASKPRED`, `%T CALENDAR`, `%T PROJWBS` tables
documentFormats.compatibilityStatus: Full parser for Primavera P6 XER schemas 8.0–22.0. Maps to `GanttTask` and `TaskDependency`.

documentFormats.name: Microsoft Project Schedule (.xml / .mpp)
documentFormats.compatibilityStatus: Bidirectional round-trip: XML import and export verified against MS Project 2016/2019.

documentFormats.name: Field Site Media (.jpg / .png)
documentFormats.internalStructure: EXIF-tagged binary JPEG with embedded GPS metadata (`latitude`, `longitude`, `timestamp`)
documentFormats.compatibilityStatus: Standard web JPEG. Replaces heavy 8MB HEIC/RAW originals with ~250KB transmission payloads.
